summary.intent: Run the plan-phase workflow for phase 41 (package and app versioning and release cycles) to generate a structured PLAN.md via research, planning, and verification stages.
summary.outcome: Research stage completed inline after a subagent got stuck on Anthropic 529 errors; RESEARCH.md was written directly by the orchestrator from canonical reference files. Planning stage had not yet begun at transcript end.

repo: Phase 41 covers package and app versioning and release cycles — a well-specified phase with ~40 decisions already captured in CONTEXT.md and a detailed DISCUSSION-LOG.md
Repo uses Release Please for versioning with both release-please-config.json and .release-please-manifest.json at the root
GitHub Actions workflows include release-please.yml, deploy-staging.yml, and release-gate.yml
Monorepo spans both JS (pnpm workspaces via pnpm-workspace.yaml) and Rust (Cargo workspace via Cargo.toml)
Desktop app is a Tauri app with config at apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
A temp planning prompt file existed at temp/plan-packageVersioningStrategy.prompt.md

code.finding: Release Please configuration root — defines per-package versioning strategy
Tracks current versions for all packages managed by Release Please
CI workflow that runs Release Please on merge to main
Release gate workflow — likely enforces conditions before production deploy
Staging deployment workflow — read twice, suggesting it needed close review
Defines JS monorepo package structure for dependency graph mapping
Rust workspace root — used to map Rust crate dependency graph
Tauri desktop app config — relevant for app versioning and release packaging

workflow: When a subagent gets stuck on upstream 529 errors, killing it and doing the work inline is faster than retrying — especially when source files are small and well-structured enough to read directly
The plan-phase workflow has a clear stage sequence: Research → Plan → Verify, with each stage gated
Background agent spawning is used for research but requires monitoring; long-running agents with API instability can silently stall without writing output
CONTEXT.md and DISCUSSION-LOG.md together provide enough context to skip or short-circuit the research agent when the phase is already well-specified

friction: Anthropic API returned repeated 529 (overloaded) errors, causing the background researcher agent to stall without producing output
No built-in timeout or health-check mechanism for background agents — user had to notice the stall and manually intervene
The orchestrator had to fall back to inline research, adding latency and context window usage that the subagent pattern was meant to avoid
open_items: Planning stage (spawning gsd-planner to produce PLAN.md) not yet started — transcript ends after RESEARCH.md was written
Both JS and Rust dependency graphs were mapped but findings not yet incorporated into a plan
